ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SOAPHound Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of SOAPHound, a .NET tool for collecting Active Directory data, using specific command-line arguments that may indicate an attempt to extract sensitive AD information.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-buildcache\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-bhdump\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-certdump\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-dnsdump\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-cachefilename\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-o\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-outputdirectory.*")))
